title: Are We Alone in the Universe? Earth-like Planet Calculator
description:
Are We Alone in the Universe? Earth-like Planet Calculator is a static browser-based scientific modelling tool for exploring assumptions about modelled Earth-like candidates across the Milky Way and the observable universe.

The calculator uses transparent astrophysical and planetary factors, scenario presets, Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation, calibration-status badges, source links, and nearest-neighbour distance models. Version 2.13 improves source traceability, calibration wording, Monte Carlo interval semantics, and radial-density nearest-distance modelling while preserving the core multiplicative model structure.

This software is exploratory. It is not an observational exoplanet catalogue and must not be interpreted as direct observational evidence or as a confirmed count of life-bearing or technological worlds.
